title: Pointer + length
theory:
## Pointer + length

A *logical slice* is `(ptr, len)` in registers. The Linux `write` syscall already wants `rsi` as pointer and `rdx` as length—use that as the mental model.

exercises.title: Middle window
exercises.description: Buffer `db '0','1','2','3','4'` lives in `.data`. Set `rsi` to address of `'2'` and `rdx` to `3`; issue one `write` to print `234` (no newline), then exit 0.
exercises.starter_code:
global _start
section .data
    buf: db '0','1','2','3','4'
section .text
_start:
    ; lea rsi ... buf+2 ; mov rdx, 3 ; write
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
exercises.solution:
global _start
section .data
    buf: db '0', '1', '2', '3', '4'
section .text
_start:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    lea rsi, [rel buf+2]
    mov rdx, 3
    syscall
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

exercises.title: Empty slice
exercises.description: Call `write` with `rdx=0` (zero-length) and any valid `rsi` (use `buf` label). Should print nothing; exit 0.
exercises.starter_code:
global _start
section .data
    buf: db 'X'
section .text
_start:
    ; write(fd=1, buf, 0)
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
exercises.solution:
global _start
section .data
    buf: db 'X'
section .text
_start:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    lea rsi, [rel buf]
    mov rdx, 0
    syscall
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

exercises.title: Pass slice to helper
exercises.description: Write `emit` that expects pointer in `rdi` and length in `rsi`, performs `write` to stdout, returns. `_start` passes `buf` and length `4` for bytes `abcd`.
exercises.starter_code:
global _start
section .data
    buf: db 'a','b','c','d'
section .text
emit:
    ret
_start:
    lea rdi, [rel buf]
    mov rsi, 4
    call emit
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
hints: Inside `emit`, `mov rax,1; mov r8,rdi; mov r9,rsi; mov rdi,1; mov rsi,r8; mov rdx,r9; syscall`
exercises.solution:
global _start
section .data
    buf: db 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd'
section .text
emit:
    mov rax, 1
    mov r8, rdi
    mov r9, rsi
    mov rdi, 1
    mov rsi, r8
    mov rdx, r9
    syscall
    ret
_start:
    lea rdi, [rel buf]
    mov rsi, 4
    call emit
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

exercises.title: Prefix window
exercises.description: Buffer `db 'p','q','r','s'` in `.data`. One `write` with `rsi` at the start and `rdx=2` must print `pq` (no newline), then exit 0.
exercises.starter_code:
global _start
section .data
    buf: db 'p','q','r','s'
section .text
_start:
    ; rsi = buf, rdx = 2
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
hints: Prefix slice: pointer is `buf`, length is `2`
exercises.solution:
global _start
section .data
    buf: db 'p', 'q', 'r', 's'
section .text
_start:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    lea rsi, [rel buf]
    mov rdx, 2
    syscall
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
